_readme: Image scenes (backdrops) for portraits, jobs, mishaps and time with Sam. Service scenes are built from services.json; date scenes come from dates.json.

Each scene: label (shown in the image menu), comp (pose/framing), setting (backdrop), and optional flags: house (adds the house's own setting), sam (Sam is in it), pov (first person), client (who else is in it), snip (a snippets.json slot to append), towel ("dressed" means wrapped in a towel here).
Add a new key to add a scene; it shows up in the scene picker on her sheet.

rooms: client room by room tier (shabby, comfortable, lavish, opulent). samRoom: where Sam's private scenes happen. clientPhrase: who's with her in client scenes. duoPhrase: added to scenes with two ladies.
